/method/: The archive's method: the tiers, the ladder of five words, how living people are handled, and what this archive learnt reading FamilySearch indexes.
/sources/: What the archive stands on, each source filed under one of six weights (state record, parish register, family tree, background, rejected, not consulted) with where it is weak.
/searched/: The Search Register: every search made, what it returned, per register with ark and image. The only complete record of what was looked at here.
/open-questions/: The open questions with what would settle each.
/errands/: The errands: every letter written to other archives, drafted, sent and answered, and the jobs that need a person in a building.
/worklist/: The work list: every open, running, blocked and done task, with the reasons for decisions.
/corrections/: Every claim published and taken back, what was said, what is true, and how it was caught; one of the pages of the linking standard.
/changes/: The hand-kept list of changes the archive has recorded about itself, newest first.
/whats-new/: The pulse: what was read, found and corrected lately, by source, newest first (stays in Start as well).
/harvest/: The worklist of registers: every person whose birth or death was written in a parish whose films can be opened, matched to the book that should hold the entry. Now in To do.
/readings/: Every document read off a page, with the citation in the register's own words.
/snapshots/: A kept photograph of the register page for each reading that has one, with film, image number and entry.
/indexed/: Which parish books can be searched as text and which must be read, measured parish by parish.
/stones/: Names read off photographs of the memorials themselves at Otočac and Senj. A deep dive now.
/hungarian-press/: The Arcanum searches of the Budapest-era press and official lists, as snippets, with the zeros. A deep dive now.
/found/: People read off a page that the family tree has never heard of, kept beside the tree by rule. A deep dive now.
/coverage/: What each person's evidence is on the direct line, added up (generated). Now in Checks.
/impossible/: Things in one record that cannot all be true at once (generated). Now in Checks.
/duplicates/: People counted as two (generated). Now in Checks.
/buckets/: Labels standing where a parent should be, and how much stands on them (generated). Now in Checks.
